scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @citadel/server" "npm run dev -w @citadel/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @citadel/shared && npm run build -w @citadel/server && npm run build -w @citadel/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @citadel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @citadel/server && npm run typecheck -w @citadel/client
